jobs.description: Overview We re looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven t existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren t chatbots waiting for questions. They re proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology. Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines. You ll work in two directions at once. Internally, you ll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you ll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace. There s no single technology stack. You ll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You ll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus). Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance. jobs.title: Project Sceptrum - Multilingual AI Coding Evaluation Specialist - Dutch
jobs.description: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. About the project Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. About the roles There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. Who we are looking for Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role. Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.
